question.de: Finde Melbourne im Südosten Australiens am Port Phillip.
question.hu: Keresd meg Melbourne-t Ausztrália délkeleti részén, a Port Phillip-öbölnél.
question.ro: Găsește Melbourne în sud-estul Australiei, la golful Port Phillip.
question.en: Find Melbourne in southeastern Australia on Port Phillip Bay.

question.de: Finde Adelaide an der Südküste Australiens.
question.hu: Keresd meg Adelaide városát Ausztrália déli partján.
question.ro: Găsește Adelaide pe coasta sudică a Australiei.
question.en: Find Adelaide on Australia's southern coast.

question.de: Finde Hobart im Süden Tasmaniens.
question.hu: Keresd meg Hobartot Tasmánia déli részén.
question.ro: Găsește Hobart în sudul Tasmaniei.
question.en: Find Hobart in southern Tasmania.

question.de: Finde Alice Springs im roten Zentrum Australiens.
question.hu: Keresd meg Alice Springst Ausztrália vörös belsejében.
question.ro: Găsește Alice Springs în centrul arid al Australiei.
question.en: Find Alice Springs in Australia's red interior.

question.de: Finde Cairns im tropischen Nordosten Australiens.
question.hu: Keresd meg Cairnst Ausztrália trópusi északkeleti részén.
question.ro: Găsește Cairns în nord-estul tropical al Australiei.
question.en: Find Cairns in tropical northeastern Australia.

question.de: Klicke auf das Northern Territory im Norden und Zentrum des Landes.
question.hu: Kattints az Északi Területre az ország északi és középső részén.
question.ro: Apasă pe Teritoriul de Nord din nordul și centrul țării.
question.en: Click the Northern Territory in the north and center of the country.

question.de: Klicke auf South Australia an der zentralen Südküste.
question.hu: Kattints Dél-Ausztráliára a középső déli partvidéken.
question.ro: Apasă pe South Australia de pe coasta sudică centrală.
question.en: Click South Australia on the central southern coast.

question.de: Finde New South Wales an der Südostküste.
question.hu: Keresd meg Új-Dél-Walest a délkeleti parton.
question.ro: Găsește New South Wales pe coasta de sud-est.
question.en: Find New South Wales on the southeastern coast.

question.de: Klicke auf Victoria südlich von New South Wales.
question.hu: Kattints Victoriára Új-Dél-Walestől délre.
question.ro: Apasă pe Victoria, la sud de New South Wales.
question.en: Click Victoria south of New South Wales.

question.de: Finde das Australian Capital Territory rund um Canberra.
question.hu: Keresd meg az Ausztrál Fővárosi Területet Canberra körül.
question.ro: Găsește Teritoriul Capitalei Australiene din jurul Canberrei.
question.en: Find the Australian Capital Territory around Canberra.

question.de: Welche dieser Städte liegt im Landesinneren statt an der Küste?
question.hu: Melyik város fekszik ezek közül a szárazföld belsejében, nem a parton?
question.ro: Care dintre aceste orașe se află în interiorul continentului, nu pe coastă?
question.en: Which of these cities lies inland rather than on the coast?

question.de: Welche dieser Städte liegt auf Tasmanien statt auf dem Festland?
question.hu: Melyik város fekszik Tasmánián, nem pedig a szárazföldön?
question.ro: Care dintre aceste orașe se află în Tasmania, nu pe continent?
question.en: Which of these cities is on Tasmania rather than the mainland?

question.de: Welche dieser Städte liegt am weitesten im Norden?
question.hu: Melyik város fekszik a legészakabbra?
question.ro: Care dintre aceste orașe se află cel mai la nord?
question.en: Which of these cities lies farthest north?

question.de: Welche dieser Städte liegt in Queensland statt in New South Wales?
question.hu: Melyik város található Queenslandben, nem pedig Új-Dél-Walesben?
question.ro: Care dintre aceste orașe se află în Queensland, nu în New South Wales?
question.en: Which of these cities is in Queensland rather than New South Wales?

question.de: Welche dieser Städte liegt am weitesten im Westen?
question.hu: Melyik város fekszik a legnyugatabbra?
question.ro: Care dintre aceste orașe se află cel mai la vest?
question.en: Which of these cities lies farthest west?

question.de: Klicke Perth, Adelaide, Melbourne und Sydney von Westen nach Osten an.
question.hu: Kattints Perthre, Adelaide-re, Melbourne-re és Sydney-re nyugatról keletre.
question.ro: Apasă pe Perth, Adelaide, Melbourne și Sydney de la vest la est.
question.en: Click Perth, Adelaide, Melbourne and Sydney from west to east.

question.de: Klicke Cairns, Mackay, Brisbane und Sydney von Norden nach Süden an.
question.hu: Kattints Cairnsre, Mackayre, Brisbane-re és Sydney-re északról délre.
question.ro: Apasă pe Cairns, Mackay, Brisbane și Sydney de la nord la sud.
question.en: Click Cairns, Mackay, Brisbane and Sydney from north to south.

question.de: Klicke Broome, Alice Springs, Adelaide und Melbourne von Westen nach Osten an.
question.hu: Kattints Broome-ra, Alice Springsre, Adelaide-re és Melbourne-re nyugatról keletre.
question.ro: Apasă pe Broome, Alice Springs, Adelaide și Melbourne de la vest la est.
question.en: Click Broome, Alice Springs, Adelaide and Melbourne from west to east.

question.de: Klicke Darwin, Brisbane, Melbourne und Hobart von Norden nach Süden an.
question.hu: Kattints Darwinra, Brisbane-re, Melbourne-re és Hobartra északról délre.
question.ro: Apasă pe Darwin, Brisbane, Melbourne și Hobart de la nord la sud.
question.en: Click Darwin, Brisbane, Melbourne and Hobart from north to south.

question.de: Klicke Devonport, Launceston und Hobart von Norden nach Süden an.
question.hu: Kattints Devonportra, Launcestonra és Hobartra északról délre.
question.ro: Apasă pe Devonport, Launceston și Hobart de la nord la sud.
question.en: Click Devonport, Launceston and Hobart from north to south.
